q: How many users signed up in total?
How many users came from each acquisition channel?
gold: SELECT acquisition_channel, COUNT(*) FROM users GROUP BY 1

q: What is the total revenue from all orders, rounded to 2 decimals?
What is the total revenue by user country?
gold: SELECT u.country, ROUND(SUM(o.revenue),2) FROM orders o JOIN users u ON u.user_id=o.user_id GROUP BY 1

q: How many cancelled subscriptions are there for each plan?
gold: SELECT plan, COUNT(*) FROM subscriptions WHERE status='cancelled' GROUP BY 1

q: Which single country has the most users?
gold: SELECT country FROM users GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

q: How many users have never placed an order?
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE user_id NOT IN (SELECT user_id FROM orders)

q: What is the average order value, rounded to 2 decimals?
How many events are there for each event name?
gold: SELECT event_name, COUNT(*) FROM events GROUP BY 1

q: How many paid_social users signed up in October 2026?
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE acquisition_channel='paid_social' AND signup_date>='2026-10-01' AND signup_date<'2026-11-01'
